paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron tapa siampute houpih inla, akiang uah: Achipihte uh lak a misi ziak in kuamah akihihnit ding ahi kei.
heading: Siampute Sianthouna
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

paite: Atanau nai, anu uh, apa uh, atapa uh, atanu uh, a-unau,
english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

paite: asanggamnu, a-ompih lai uh nungak, pasal nei nailoute ziak in ahihleh akihihnin thei ding uh.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

paite: Hiai bang ahih kei ngalleh, achipihte uh lak a intekpen ahih ziak in akihihnin ding ahi kei.
english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

paite: "Alu uh ametgiau ding uh ahi kei. Akhamul sik tuak uh leng atantom ding uh ahi kei. Asa uh leng a-atkeh ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

paite: A Pathian uh a ding in misiangthou ahi ding ua, a Pathian min ahemsak ding ahi kei hi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, a Pathian a dia nek ding ansiahte alat ziak in asiangthou ding ahi.
english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

paite: Numei kizuak hiam, min hem hiam, apasal maksa hiam akitenpih ding ahi kei, a Pathian a ding in misiangthou ahi ngal a.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

paite: Huaiziak in amah na siangthousak ding ahi; ama'n na Pathian tanghou alat ziak in, nang a ding in asiangthou ding hi. Kei, TOUPA, nou hon hihsiangthoupa lah ka siangthou ngal a.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

paite: Siampu kuapeuh tanu kizuak a, akihihthanghuai leh apa ahihthanghuai ahi a, mei a hal ding ahi.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

paite: "A-unaute lak a siampu lian, alu sathau nilhsa, puansilh dia sehtuamsa in alukhuhna alakhe ding ahi kei. Apuante abotkek ding ahi kei.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

paite: Misi luang omna ah alut ding ahi kei. Anu hiam, apa hiam ziak in akihihnin ding ahi sam kei hi.
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

paite: Mun siangthou a pan apawtkhe ding ahi kei. A Pathian' mun siangthou ahihthanghuai ding ahi sam kei hi. A Pathian sathau nilhna lah atung ah a-om ngal a; Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.

paite: Zi ding in nungak siangthou akitenpih ding ahi.
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

paite: Meithai hiam, maksa hiam, numei min hem hiam, kizuak hiam akitenpih ding ahi kei. Amah chipih, nungak siangthou zi ding in akitenpih ding ahi.
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

paite: Achipihte lak ah asuante ahihnin ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA'N amah ka hihsiangta ngal a, chi in,” achi hi.
english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron kiang ah, asuante lak a na khang ua demna ding nei peuhmah in a Pathian a dia ansiah lan ding in hon zuan kei hen.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

paite: Kuapeuh melhemna nei in ahon naih het louh ding ahi. Mittaw, khebai, nakpek ahihkeileh akan-aval a om peuhmah;
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

paite: ahihkeileh khe kitan, khut kitan,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

paite: ahihkeileh nungkul, mineu lua, mit sia, meima damthei lou nei ahihkeileh chiltang kitam,
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

paite: siampu Aaron suan gensiatna ding nei himhim in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat lan ding in ahon naih ding ahi kei. Gensiatna ding nei ahi a, a Pathian a dia sehtuam an lan dia ahon naih het louh ding ahi.
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

paite: A Pathian a dia an siangthou leh siangthoupen ahihleh ane thei ding hi.
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

paite: Himahleh gensiatna ding nei ahih ziak in puanzak sung ah hiam, maitam kiangnai ah hiam ahong pai thei kei ding. Ka mun siangthoute ahihnin kha ding hi. Kei TOUPA amah hihsiangthoupa ka hi ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel suante tengteng kiang ah agenta hi.
english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
